candidates.title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or design engineer, urban development (Melbourne or Geelong)
candidates.content_text: Cossill & Webley careers pages read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT. Current Opportunities: 'With growing teams across Perth, Melbourne and Geelong, we're always looking for talented individuals to join us ... No current openings? We'd still love to hear from you. Send your CV to careers@cosweb.com.au'. Listed roles are Senior Design Engineer Melbourne (7 to 15+ years) and an EOI for Contract Superintendent Perth; no graduate vacancy is listed, so this is a speculative enquiry. Graduate Program page: two-year program with rotations across civil or electrical projects, mentoring toward chartership; 'Cossill & Webley typically recruits graduate engineers at mid-year and end-of-year'; 'You can also register your interest by sending a covering letter and your resume to careers@cosweb.com.au'. Urban development described as 'the planning, design and delivery of roads, drainage and essential infrastructure that support growing communities'; projects across Victoria and Western Australia, commonly in growing outer metropolitan areas. Career pathways: design engineering, drafting, construction engineering and project engineering. Employee-owned civil and electrical engineering consultancy.
candidates.apply_instructions: Email a covering letter and resume to careers@cosweb.com.au as invited on https://www.cossillwebley.com.au/careers/graduate-program/ and the Current Opportunities page. Label clearly as a speculative enquiry / expression of interest.
supported_contributions: Road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries, from the Advanced Diploma (February 2026)
Site inspections, quality checks and drawing reviews from Philippines project-in-charge work in 2019
Site reports, material records and progress reports from residential subdivision finishing works as a field engineer 2019 to 2020

candidates.title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
candidates.content_text: City of Greater Geelong PageUp job 500747, read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT. Two positions, Permanent Full Time (part time considered), Band 6 $98,633.63 pa plus super. Manage the City's civil infrastructure network (roads, footpaths, bridges, associated civil assets); coordinate and assess third-party road reserve works and heavy-vehicle access applications; engineering investigations and recommendations; support planning and delivery of capital works; train and support others in the team. About you: experience in civil engineering; tertiary or technical qualifications in civil engineering or construction highly desirable. Essential Experience: experience undertaking infrastructure investigations, assessing engineering issues and providing technical advice relating to roads, footpaths, bridges or associated civil infrastructure assets; stakeholder management; written and verbal communication; planning and prioritisation; apply civil engineering principles, legislation, standards and policies to roads, road-reserve access and civil infrastructure with an appreciation of drainage interfaces; current Victorian Drivers Licence; National Police Check. Enquiries: Aaron McGlade, Coordinator Civil Infrastructure Planning, AMcGlade@geelongcity.vic.gov.au. Applications close 28 Oct 2026 11:55 PM AEDT.
candidates.apply_instructions: Apply now on the City of Greater Geelong PageUp board (job 500747) by 11:55pm AEDT 28 October 2026.
